scenario: LCON.4.3.1 adapter-mock contract — the harness supplies a mocked `call` response for the (svc.read) service. A rule calls svc.read with correlation "corr1" and an `on response.ok == true` continuation; the catalogue mock asserts the service's own response fact, SvcReadReply(corr="corr1", ok=true) ([LCRS.4.3.2]), when the call fires, so the continuation runs and logs. Pins that adapter calls return the mocked response (LCON.4.3.2) with no real adapter traffic.
rules_ds:
schema SvcReadReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    ok: Bool

service svc.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcReadReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min as "corr1"
        on response.ok == true:
            log info "got response"
